images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic production-quality SDtrust desktop application UI concept, landscape 1440x1024. This is a design exploration, not a working product. The attached screenshot is a BRAND reference only: use its navy, warm ivory, restrained coral and Manrope-like type, but REMOVE EVERYTHING OUTSIDE THE APP. The generated image must be exactly the flat app content filling the entire canvas, edge to edge, no perspective, no outer rounded frame, no wallpaper, no taskbar, no browser chrome, no titlebar controls, NO PET OR MASCOT anywhere. One single screen, not a collage.
Concept name: Quiet overview. LIGHT MODE. Professional everyday organization knowledge assistant for SD Worx. Audience wants current trustworthy knowledge with minimal interruptions. Spacious desktop composition. 220px navy left sidebar with SDtrust wordmark, refined simple line icons, navigation Overzicht (active with a coral fine left marker), Kennis, Bronnen, Experts, then divider and Notities. Bottom Instellingen and compact user Alex. No invented elaborate logo, modest recognizable coral circular SDtrust mark.
Warm white main canvas. Main heading upper left 'Goedemorgen, Alex.' small subtitle 'Wat wil je zeker weten?' A small 'Voorbeelddata' label upper right clearly identifies fictional content. An elegant dominant search composer stretches across the main column with placeholder 'Stel een vraag over je organisatie' and a restrained navy submit button 'Zoek antwoord'. Under search use a quiet two-column layout: left 65% 'Aandacht nodig' with exactly two spacious flat rows separated by hairlines: 'Atlas onboarding' with 'Verantwoordelijke gewijzigd' and small amber 'Te bevestigen', then 'Handleiding loonmutaties' with 'Nieuwe versie beschikbaar' and a muted date '20 okt 2026'. Each row a small arrow, no unnecessary card grid. Bottom left 'Recent bekeken' with two simple document rows 'Onboarding Atlas' and 'Werkafspraken payroll'. Right 35% one pale ivory supporting panel titled 'Verder met je werk', small explanatory copy 'Je gesprekken en notities op één plek.' with two honest text links 'Open gesprekken' and 'Open notities', no fake charts or metrics. Lots of intentional whitespace. Bottom tiny helper 'Controleer altijd de bron bij belangrijke beslissingen.'
Text legible polished Dutch, short labels, no long lorem ipsum. Date anchor 20 October 2026. Realistic 15px body, 32px heading, comfortable 44px controls. Navy #192D46, ivory #F8F6F1, coral #EE6558 used sparingly, muted bluegrey text. No large gradient, no saturated colorful tiles, no AI sparkle, no stock portraits. This LIGHT screenshot will later get a matching dark-mode version with identical content and geometry, so keep structure very clear.

Create the matching DARK MODE version of this exact SDtrust app UI. Quiet restrained high-contrast professional dark app, no neon, no gradients, no blue glow. Keep 'Voorbeelddata' and every date and label. Current date 20 October 2026. Concept: Review desk, a practical compact working app with a slim navy left rail 76px wide holding SDtrust circular mark and simple line icons. Selected list item has a fine coral edge, 'Atlas onboarding', subtitle 'Verantwoordelijke gewijzigd', small amber status 'Te bevestigen'. Next item 'Loonmutaties', subtitle 'Nieuwe handleiding', neutral status 'Nieuw'. At bottom text links 'Alle kennis', 'Notities', 'Instellingen'.
Main workspace white, readable and task focused. Top breadcrumb 'Kennis / Atlas onboarding', tiny label 'Voorbeelddata' on far right. Large title 'Wie is nu verantwoordelijk?' supporting line 'Bekijk het verschil en bevestig wat klopt.' Under title, small subdued metadata 'Nieuw signaal ontvangen op 20 oktober 2026'.
Central main area has TWO ALIGNED COLUMNS separated by simple thin rule, not thick cards. Left heading 'Eerder bevestigd' with modest gray status dot, right 'Nieuw signaal' with amber dot. Each has large team name, left 'Team HR', right 'Team Operations'. Under each 3 short text lines describing identical responsibilities 'Documenten klaarzetten', 'Welkomstmail versturen', 'Toegang aanvragen'. A small colored change marker emphasizes only the changed owner. Preserve generous whitespace and avoid long paragraphs.
Below a thin line and source row with document icon, 'Teamnotitie Atlas', date '20 oktober 2026', link 'Lees de bron'. Beneath, another quiet row 'Hulp nodig?' and initials avatar 'NP', 'Noor Peeters', 'Procesexpert', action 'Vraag om toelichting'. Lower anchored action area within normal app flow, navy primary button 'Klopt, bevestigen', outline secondary 'Nog niet zeker'. Helper text 'Je bevestiging wordt bij dit onderwerp bewaard.' Far bottom small status text 'Voorbeeld van een controle, geen echte wijziging.'
The whole composition must look like a polished working knowledge review tool, not dashboard marketing. 15px body, 30px title, accessible contrast, well aligned strong typography, 44px buttons. No charts, fake confidence percentages, notifications counter overload, blue glow or decorative gradients. All Dutch text clean readable and no hyphens/em dashes. Date anchor October 20 2026. Later a dark version will preserve exact layout.
